== Chapter I of Steelyell: Strike the Earth! Not too hard... ==

'''Date: Pregame'''

Fort name: Delertaron (Steelyell)<br />
Group Name: Bembul Mabdug (The mechanism of ale)<br />

Supplies:<br />
2 picks.<br />
1 axe.<br />
120 drink.<br />
120 food.<br />
30 plump helmet seeds.<br />
1 Anvil.<br />
2+ dogs.<br />
1 cat. (FOR ARMOKS SAKE! JUST ONE CAT!)<br />

The king sent me a letter stating the above, and that I would be leading the group<br />
into the wild and unknown for a place in history. Well, I best get to the depot and<br />
find the others before the king finds out I am still here.<br />


== 7th Granite, 201, Early Spring.  ==
'''The start of the end'''<br />
Early in the day we spotted a large volcano in the distance, the nearby<br />
river and forests were ideal for our new home. After a few hours of<br />
walking we reached the place and set down. Uploading was fast and<br />
we instantly got to work with carving our place in the mountain to call<br />
home. We started to clear the area as our hunter left to go, well, hunt.<br />
We are setting up the fort to have good access to the magma we so much<br />
need to forge our weapons and to be in a good place for defend from<br />
anything we may need to defend from. The wolves should be easy to take<br />
care of with our dogs, but the fire imps will be a problem in the future, I can<br />
feel it in my bones, so we will need to make some magma rivers to use. <br />
Back to work!<br />


== 24th of Granite, 201, early spring. ==
'''Three legs better then none'''<br />
We lost a hunting dog to unknown reasons, and another lost a leg...<br />
I think the hunter can take a break to go fish for now. Progress is slow but steady on the fort<br />


== 17th of Slate, 201, Mid-Spring. ==
'''Copper Popper'''<br />
Hit copper, and we NEED more miners, so we will need to forge up some picks.<br />


== 24th Felsite, 201, Late spring. ==
'''Horrible!'''<br />
Fire imps and such have attacked our workers!<br />
We have only 5 left!<br />
Horrible!<br />
Luckily we got the magma area off so we can still get magma without being in danger!<br />
I have been wounded in the fight and am resting as the others work.<br />


== 19th Hematite, 201, Early Summer. ==
'''Oh my...'''<br />
I seem to have gone insane...<br />

== 28th Hematite, 201, mid-summer. ==
'''As I float above my burning self...'''<br />
...I notice I have seemed to thrown myself into<br />
the rivers of magma outside our fort...<br />
I do hope a ghost is a good leader.<br />


== 3rd of Limestone, 201, Early Autumn. ==
'''WE HAVE PUPPIES!'''<br />
(Puppy at least)<br />
...<br />
Oh my Armok puppies everywhere, it seems that we<br />
shall feast tonight!<br />

==12th of Sandstone, 201, Mid-Autumn.==
'''Report to the mountain homes from traders'''<br />
The fort is tiny, I can't even see where they made the copper they sold us, as I see no <br />forges, they must be hidden or something. Anyhow I heard some horrible sounds coming from behind a<br /> door in the fort which put me off. They seem to have some fine bed rooms, more then they need.<br /> And I can't seem to be worried at the fact that their are only 4 dwarves working here.<br />
Other then that, they are having a fine feast tonight with us<br />
<br />
Armok be with these poor souls<br />

==Final log of the ghost of ilikehl2.==
'''SPRING IS HERE!'''
Thank Armok!<br />
As it seems I am fading away into nothingness, I can't help but feel sorry for what I got<br />
these nice Dwarves into. I also can't help but notice no one has found me to be dead yet, they<br />
just follow the notes around the fort, assuming I am somewhere else. Well, at least I cane leave<br />these hell hole now, as I seem to be freed of it. I wish them the best of luck with<br />
this horrible place, and maybe it will become something of legend in the future.<br />
<br />
My Reign of Horror is over.<br />
